core.title: 3/8 Diameter Protected Shackle Padlock, Mul-T-Lock G55P

text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 206SP-G55P 3/8" Diameter Protected Shackle Padlock

The G-series Padlocks from Mul-T-Lock are a medium security solution that offers great value for money. This brass body padlock is anti-corrosive in all weather conditions and its 3/8" hardened boron alloy shackle make it tamper resistant. The High Shackle Protector adds increased security form cutting attempts. This, with the incorporate Mul-T-Lock High Security lock cylinder make it a good choice for general home, industrial and commercial use.

MUL-T-LOCK's high security lock cylinders are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

The shackle is locked with a double ball bearing mechanism. 90 degree key rotation unlocks the padlock.

Features for Mul-T-Lock G55P Protected Shackle Padlock

  • 3/8" Diameter Hardened Boron Alloy Protected Shackle
  • High Corrosion Resistant Brass Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206SP Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock G55P Protected Shackle Padlock

  • Shackle Diameter: 3/8" (10mm)
  • Total Height: 3-1/32" (77mm)
  • Total Width: 2-1/8" (55mm)
  • Total Thickness: 7/8" (21mm)
  • Clearance: 15/16" (23mm)
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK G55P Padlock Specifications Diagram (PDF)

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.
